legal.privacy.meta: duskline privacy policy: what stays in your browser, how location is used for forecasts, and which weather providers receive requests.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: A clear explanation of what stays in your browser and what is sent to weather providers.
legal.privacy.p1: duskline has no accounts, profiles, advertising identifiers, or private dashboard. Your language, unit preference, favorites, cached responses, and an approximate saved location may be stored locally in your browser. This information is not uploaded to duskline.
legal.privacy.p2: If you choose “Use my location,” your browser asks for permission. duskline uses the result to request a forecast and rounds saved coordinates to reduce precision. Reverse geocoding is requested from BigDataCloud and, if that fails, OpenStreetMap Nominatim, so those services receive the rounded coordinates. You can deny permission, remove the saved pin in the app, clear favorites, or clear site data at any time.
legal.privacy.p3: Weather requests are made directly by your browser to Open-Meteo and, for eligible U.S. forecasts and alerts, the U.S. National Weather Service. Those services receive the request information required to answer it and maintain their own privacy policies.
legal.privacy.p4: duskline is a static site hosted through deployment infrastructure. Hosting providers may process ordinary technical information such as an IP address, browser details, and request time for security and delivery. The app also loads fonts from Google Fonts. duskline does not sell that information.
legal.privacy.p5: This policy may be updated when the app or its providers change. The effective date above identifies the current version. For questions about this policy, contact the duskline maintainer through the project’s public repository: {repo}.
legal.terms.meta: duskline terms of use: browser weather forecasts for planning and exploration, data from public providers, not for emergency decisions.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
legal.terms.intro: Please use duskline as a planning and exploration tool, not as a source of emergency instructions.
legal.terms.p1: duskline is a browser-based weather interface that presents forecasts, current conditions, air-quality information, and public alerts from third-party providers. The service is provided for general informational use.
legal.terms.p2: Weather data can be delayed, incomplete, unavailable, or inaccurate. duskline is not an emergency service and does not guarantee that an alert will appear. For life-safety decisions, follow official instructions from local authorities and the National Weather Service or equivalent authority in your region.
legal.terms.p3: The app depends on public APIs, networks, browsers, and static hosting. Any of these may change or become unavailable without notice. Provider names, attribution, and applicable license terms remain with their respective owners.
legal.terms.p4: Use duskline lawfully and responsibly. Do not interfere with the app, overload provider services, or rely on it where a professional or official source is required.
legal.terms.p5: These terms may be revised as the app evolves. Continued use after the effective date means you accept the updated terms.
